# Marcella Mission Therapy

> Holistic, relational, and integrative therapy for individuals and couples in San Francisco and online across California. Pre-Licensed Professional supervised by Derek Pehle, PsyD #21361.

## Practice Overview
- **Therapist:** Marcella Mission (Pre-Licensed Professional)
- **Clinical Supervision:** Derek Pehle, PsyD (CA License #21361)
- **Affiliation:** Church Street Integral Counseling Center
- **Practice Location:** 1782 Church St, San Francisco, CA 94131
- **Website:** https://marcellamissiontherapy.pages.dev/

## Contact & Appointments
- **Email:** marcella.mission.therapy@gmail.com
- **Phone / SMS:** 415-373-6223
- **Free Consultation:** Complimentary 15-minute consultation by phone or video.

## Services & Fees
- **Individual Therapy** — $80 / Session (50 mins)
  - In-person in San Francisco or online via Telehealth. Tailored, holistic support focusing on the here and now, bringing gentle awareness to present-moment experience.
- **Couples & Relational Therapy** — $80 / Session (50 mins)
  - Relational and integrative support for couples and partners navigating life transitions, communication patterns, intimacy, and deeper connection.

## Crisis Information
If you are experiencing a life-threatening emergency, please call 911 or visit your nearest emergency room. You can also call or text the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline at 988 (24/7).
